human_sources.role: The approximate-cochain correction, finite preparation of two subsequent comparisons, transported old states and coefficients, action-preserving gauge, and convergence of both actual coefficient limits are the classical strategy in [Masuda], Lemma 5.2 and Section 6. The estimates below use the programme’s exact internal towers, weighted squared sharp norms and two original-factor coefficient pairs. The scalar associator is retained throughout. These calculations explain and apply the classical strategy; they do not establish a new comparison method.
